title: Excellent tour
text: The tour was absolutely magical. From the drive into the mountains to the sunset itself, it was a great experience. Our tour guide Julio was knowledgeable and very helpful.
author: Nora_A

title: It allows you to see some...
text: It allows you to see some incredible landscapes and, with a little luck, also animals like mountain goats. The sunset at 2500m was beautiful and Julio - our guide - was very pleasant and professional. He gave us information about the area and wildlife and didn't mind taking photos of us. This activity is highly recommended!
author: Katharina_W

title: Julio was an excellent...
text: Julio was an excellent guide, very informative and very kind. He also took a lot pictures for us! During the trip we make a few stops along the way to admire the mountain views and some goats. We had a short walk to reach the sunset viewpoint and than we admire the beauty of Nature.  An amazing 4 hour tour.
author: valentina_b

title: Sierra Nevada sunset trip in winter
text: We had a wonderful  daytrip with Julio took us 3 different viewpts. Each unique on its own While weather was  cloudy we still could see the wild and beautiful landscape including native wild animals like horses and mountain goats, thyme bushes etc. Best surprise waiting for us-light snowfall at 2500m and lots of photo memories.
author: Likoon T

title: Great trip with Julio- Sunset Sierra Navada
text:
Julio was an excellent tour guide!
It didn't take long maybe 45 mins/ hours to get to the top.
We stopped to see the reservoir and took more pictures and Julio explained how the rain rushes in winter/February/ March/ April to fill the reservoir. I think it would be very green and lush in May!
We also saw many mountain goats and he explained that they would show off their agility in the rutting season.
At the top there were again some more AMAZING pictures!!
Thank you Julio for a lovely adventure!
author: JaneB4104

title: Great trip 10/10
text:
A really amazing trip with Julio. Julio kept us updated before the trip (due to dodgy weather conditions), met us and gave us a great experience as advertised. 
The group nature of the trip is also great for meeting fellow travellers. 10/ 10 would recommend to anybody in Granada.
Thanks again!
Jon and Walaa
author: Jon_M

title: Peaceful and picturesque sunset tour
text: Julio was a fantastic guide and allowed us plenty of time to take in the views and sunset. We managed to see some wild horses which truly one of the highlights. He kindly stopped on the way back to let us buy some fresh honey! The perfect way to spend our last evening in Granada.
author: 688haleemak

title: Unforgettable experience
text: Unforgettable family experience. We're joined by Julio, you endearing professional. Very nice. It's the second activity he's done with him, great.
author: canarias2015

title: Such an epic view
text: Julio was so incredibly nice. He is a Brazilian living in Spain which makes for interesting conversation if you ask him about himself. I personally like to hike but this trip was perfect if you have limited time in Granada. It isn’t really a hike but the view is spectacular. Could not stop admiring the snowcapped mountains, the view of the city, and the beautiful sunset.
author: Cole S

title: A must-do in Granada
text:
Excellent trip up into the mountains to get away from city life. Our guide, Julio, was very informative and always keeping his eye out for wildlife. 
   We saw wild horses, mountain goats and a very curious fox. He stopped to let us take pictures and was always willing to take pictures of the group. 
   The mountain top provides terrific views. A chance to see the sunset from 8350 feet. Simply gorgeous!
author: nbgoose
